name: @humid/sdjwt
description: HumID 4.0 (provisional): SD-JWT (RFC 9901) and SD-JWT VC verification with key binding, the JOSE a verifier needs (JWS verify, x5c chains, JWK thumbprints, ECDH-ES JWE decrypt), and IETF Token Status List revocation checks (JWT and CWT). EU digital identity PID and other SD-JWT credentials. No platform code, no network.
